MDM System Extensions marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general localization guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers evaluate macOS extension governance — not a literal paste of US marketing:

系统扩展 / System Extensions

Enterprise MDM marketing uses 系统扩展 alongside the English term System Extensions when describing MDM-configured macOS system extension approval on enrolled fleet Macs. Apple documentation and Chinese IT admin materials also use System Extensions in English on technical mockups. AppLocale picks phrasing buyers recognize on each screenshot — an extension approval editor needs 系统扩展-friendly headlines; a benefit line may keep System Extensions when accurate to your English source.

系统扩展批准 (system extension approval)

When MDM System Extensions workflows approve or deny system extensions before they load on fleet Macs, zh-Hans enterprise docs use 系统扩展批准. Use when your gallery shows "System extension approval" overlays, allow or deny extension toggles, or extension compliance panels — distinct from 门禁 Gatekeeper notarization vocabulary.

团队 ID 白名单 (team-ID allowlist)

MDM policies that allow system extensions only from approved Apple Developer team IDs map to 团队 ID 白名单 on admin-console frames. Use when your English source markets team-ID allowlist editors, approved team ID lists, or "Team ID allowlist" badges — distinct from 证书管理 Certificate Management SCEP vocabulary unless your frame shows cert enrollment specifically.

Endpoint Security 扩展 / DriverKit 扩展 / 网络扩展

When marketing frames emphasize specific system extension types, use Endpoint Security 扩展 for Endpoint Security extensions, DriverKit 扩展 for DriverKit extensions, and 网络扩展 for Network Extension approval workflows — aligned with whether your UX leads with Endpoint Security compliance dashboards, DriverKit extension governance, or Network Extension allowlists on fleet Macs.

Technical mockups and admin docs may reference sysextd — the macOS system extension daemon — with brief native benefit lines where Chinese IT admins expect them. Do not conflate sysextd with spctl Gatekeeper assessment or socketfilterfw Application Firewall tools unless your English source markets both on separate frames.

AppLocale FAQ

What are MDM macOS System Extensions and why does listing copy matter?

System Extensions cover MDM and Configuration Profile System Extensions payloads that govern macOS system extension approval on enrolled Macs — team-ID allowlists, DriverKit, Network Extension, and Endpoint Security extension management. Marketing those workflows on your en-US page does not auto-fill zh-Hans Connect fields.

Does MDM System Extensions auto-translate my China listing?

No. System Extensions payloads are runtime MDM workflows — they do not create or fill a Simplified Chinese localization row. Empty or English zh-Hans fields mean China buyers see en-US fallback on the product page.

What listing fields does AppLocale rewrite for System Extensions apps?

Paste-ready Simplified Chinese (zh-Hans) copy for App Store Connect listing fields you specify: title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text when included, and screenshot overlay or caption lines that mention System Extensions, system extension approval, team-ID allowlists, DriverKit, or Endpoint Security — rewritten from your English originals with terms like 系统扩展, 系统扩展批准, and 团队 ID 白名单 where accurate.

How is this different from Gatekeeper?

System Extensions listing copy markets macOS system extension approval and team-ID allowlists on enrolled Macs. Gatekeeper listing copy markets software source and notarization policy — App Store only vs identified developers vs anywhere. Listing vocabulary must follow your English lead feature.

How is this different from Application Firewall or Managed Login Items?

System Extensions govern low-level extension approval and team-ID allowlists. Application Firewall controls inbound network connections. Managed Login Items govern macOS startup persistence at login. Each is a separate Apple MDM surface — do not reuse boilerplate across them.

How is this different from Configuration Profiles or Certificate Management?

System Extensions configure extension approval policy. Configuration Profiles distribute installable .mobileconfig payload files — System Extensions may ride inside a profile, but profile distribution is not the extension-approval lead. Certificate Management handles SCEP and identity certificate lifecycle.
